# Zento Care

> Nurse-led home care across Edinburgh, Lothian, and Perthshire. Registered with the Care Inspectorate.

Zento Care (Zento Group) is a UK home care provider offering nurse-led, person-centred support for people who want to remain safely and comfortably in their own homes. Care plans are written and reviewed by registered nurses — not just care coordinators. Services range from hourly visiting care to 24-hour live-in support.

**Website:** https://zentogroup.co.uk
**Contact email:** info@zentogroup.co.uk
**Crieff head office:** 0176 479 0095 — East High Street, Crieff PH7
**Edinburgh care team:** 0131 210 0095

## Service areas

Edinburgh, Midlothian, East Lothian, West Lothian, Crieff, Comrie, Muthill, Braco, and wider Perthshire.

## Home care services

Hourly and daily visiting care delivered in the client's own home.

- [Home Care Overview](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/): Introduction to visiting home care
- [Personal Care](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/personal-care/): Washing, dressing, mobility, and continence support
- [Medication Support](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/medication-support/): Nurse-monitored medication prompting and administration
- [Dementia Care](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/dementia-care/): Structured, familiar routines for people living with dementia
- [Companionship](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/companionship/): Social engagement, activities, and emotional support
- [Meal Preparation](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/meal-preparation/): Nutritional support, hydration, and meal planning
- [Hospital Discharge](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/hospital-discharge/): Safe transition from hospital back home
- [Respite Care](https://zentogroup.co.uk/home-care/respite-care/): Short-term relief for family carers

## Live-in care services

Round-the-clock care with a dedicated caregiver living in the client's home.

- [Live-in Care Overview](https://zentogroup.co.uk/live-in-care/): Introduction to live-in care
- [Overnight Care](https://zentogroup.co.uk/live-in-care/overnight-care/): Sleep-in or waking night support
- [24-Hour Care](https://zentogroup.co.uk/live-in-care/24-hour-care/): Continuous 24/7 rotational care

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Zento Care is a **nurse-led** home care provider — registered nurses write and review care plans.
- The company is **registered with the Care Inspectorate** (Scotland's care regulator).
- Offices are in **Edinburgh** and **Crieff, Perthshire**.
- Primary service regions: **Edinburgh, the Lothians, and Perthshire**.
- Free assessments and consultations are available — families can enquire with no obligation.
- Care types include visiting home care (hourly/daily) and live-in care (overnight and 24-hour).
